mikeramp72 All-Stars Confessional Questions #1 <:bubububub:1...
• i’m feeling really jazzed to be here umm all star seasons aren’t really my thing noah fence i don’t tend to place well because i’m less involved with the strategy of orgs than i am with the social aspect and i feel like all star seasons tend to invite a lot of pregamey-ness, meta, and chudmaxxing that isn’t really for me but i couldn’t say no to fio and seeing the cast i don’t think that’ll be the case. i feel happy for the opportunity to redeem myself from the clutches of 2nd place and i do think it’ll be a fun time regardless i’m glad i was chosen to represent the cast of 24 in what will probably be my last org for the foreseeable future. i know people say that but i mean it ngl

• i’m doing a cast assessment soon so a lot of the cast questions will be answered when i do that but i do know a lot of these people and am dating one castaway in griffin mk (we are rob and amber ig) i’m not sure how i’ll do because of that but i’ll elaborate later

• if i had to take a guess on the twist that has to do with pvz2 i’d guess something like a shop or abilities you can unlock similar to what happened in s1 with btd5. i think there might be some type of currency like with the sun and there could be events for each role like the garden and the undead that they can do certain things at different times

• i love @-Fio‼️ because they have been one of my best friends for over 3 years and have been there for the highs and the lows. i mean i’ve literally known them since they were 16 and now they are turning 21 and i will probably be coming to their 21st birthday like who is cutting the onions 🧅 😭 they have matured a lot as a person over the years and have always been a blunt, genuine, and fun person to be around. they make every moment worthwhile and i’m so grateful to be playing their org again
i love @-Lezaria | {S9} and @-fishpog | {S1; S6} because they help run aux wars smoothly with me and we can rig to our heart’s content (y’all didn’t see this) but i wouldn’t choose anybody else to rank music with
i love @-Sin | {S9} because they have been a comfort person. i got close to sin fast but there’s a reason why. i just feel like we have a ton in common on a personal level and i can vent anything to them. they’d be my 2nd confessional buddy if they weren’t already hosting and we talk pretty much everyday.
i love @-Syn | {S9} because they are such a ki and a vibe. we ran live updates together last season and i’m sad that can’t be the case this time but they have always kept it REAL REAL with me and were such an iconic part of last season’s prejury. (and have a good taste in music)
i love @-Mike | {S9} and @-Layton | {S5; S9} because they are both genuine people in the community who put a lot of their heart into things and the people around them from what i’ve seen.
i love @fortnitefred2005 {S4} i don’t know why because i don’t really know lily but i love them anyways.

TRIBAL À LA CARTE @-Fio‼️ @-Syn | {S9} @-fishpog | {S1; S6} (pinging for your host updates)

me and saturn hit it off really fast and we compared notes about the game i leaked everything to him like about the women’s alliance. he told me about his half idol and gave me information about how bazz has side deals with kebab and virgo and also created the old school villains’ majority alliance so he was like “should we get the vote on bazz?” i said i’d consider it because he seemed to be running the game even though it was a huge move at f22 i didn’t see myself trusting him. saturn took this as a green light and decided to get the vote on bazz by telling all of the heroes more notably neptune that he had a half idol too.

so during the whole morning, the vote gets flipped on bazz for being a huge threat who’s orchestrating alliances and side deals by saturn and we have the numbers. me and saturn start tweaking mildly because no one was saying anything and he wanted a live tribal so he decides to leak his own vote plan to bazz and mentioned how it was his idea and that he “messed up”. 💀 bazz knows at this point and is trying to flip it off him. he decides to go for sylvia as an inactive player but this was just a ruse. we bite on it for a bit and stick on sylvia. the villains aren’t saying anything and then we get an alliance chat of only heroes where there is a live discussion between who to vote of sylvia and bazz. there’s some push back from me and dallas to do sylvia because bazz is a threat but i am also admittedly undecided at this point. i leak it to sylvia because i’m not not gonna tell her she’s getting votes she had my back in s7. eventually we settle on bazz through compromise.

but then saturn messages me that the villains have a secret plan to do neptune. i basically plead for this not to happen because neptune is my closest connection on heroes and it would put me in a bad spot. saturn and griffin are up bazz’s ass and want to do a vini vote. i agreed with it because i had off feelings about drew and vini. also because at the same time sylvia pulled me and penelope into a chat and mentioned how there’s rumors of a women’s alliance from heroes being spread and that we need to be wary and stick together so that worsened paranoia. the blame got pinned on neptune. (it could’ve just been me telling saturn and he didn’t out me but i don’t know)
but this is why i was okay with a vini or drew vote. i felt like i was not in a high priority for either? which could be wrong but they were upset by the enya vote and i heard things they hadn’t told me and that i had spearheaded the enya vote from drew? so the vote flips from vini to drew from the 4 of us. neptune wasn’t a fan because he was being strongarmed from the bottom or he’d go home. me and neptune leaked everything to penelope and got her to vote with us. sylvia and brent weren’t going to vote vini so it had to be drew or dallas, but brent wasn’t a fan of the drew vote either.

so that leads us to a 6-3-2-1 with tension and people being scapegoated from both tribes. neptune and me fought griffin on call.

currently it’s a hot mess. brent and me just had an argument in the safari which ended up with him unfriending me so i can imagine i am in a bit of hot water with some of the villains should we go back to tribal on old school. neptune doesn’t trust saturn or griffin. griffin and saturn don’t trust neptune. (even though we all voted together) i feel weirdly in the middle but also not. i don’t really trust bazz, brent, or jiv. even though jiv was mia during the tribal. dallas and vini might be feeling off towards me and penelope. brent doesn’t trust saturn or griffin i think. bazz doesn’t trust saturn.
